title: polyqep: PolyQEP framework, PW-R/PW-RG reduced-order models, and reproduction scripts
description: Reference implementation of PolyQEP, a framework that represents a frequency-dependent complex modulus by piecewise-quadratic segments and solves one quadratic eigenvalue problem per segment, together with the PW-R and PW-RG reduced-order models. This version adds the reproduction directory: comparison baselines (GHM, ADF, Krylov reductions of Xie et al. 2018), benchmark scripts, result files, and figures of the revised paper "PolyQEP: Piecewise-quadratic moduli and segmentwise quadratic eigenproblems for fast frequency response of viscoelastically damped structures" (S.-H. Bae, S. Baek, T. Kim, I. Song) and of its Supplementary Material.
